title: People by customer

intro.title: You decide which factory people work for which customer.
intro.body: The customer and sales then pick only from these people, for a group or an order. A customer reads the name of a factory person only when you gave that person to that customer. Floor people are not here.

readOnly: Only the owner and an admin change this page. You can read it.
foot: A person you take out leaves the groups and the orders of that customer. The history keeps it.

extraHint.ALLOW_PRODUCTION: Sees the baskets board, the chains and an order’s Production tab
extraHint.PRINT_AND_START: Prints and starts the work of an order
